chars.NARRATOR: a 32-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her mid-thirties wearing a burgundy headscarf and a long light grey knitted cardigan
chars.BROTHER_IN_LAW: a Moroccan man around 40, bald with a thick black moustache, wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a white shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: BROTHER_IN_LAW stands in a Casablanca hospital corridor holding a phone to his ear, mid-call, worried face clearly visible, one hand on his forehead, head-to-waist framing, seen from a few steps away

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SISTER lies in a hospital bed in a simple Moroccan public hospital room, eyes open, looking toward the door hopefully, a small white bandage on her forehead, arm in a sling, soft afternoon light, non-graphic

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR rushes out of a Casablanca apartment building onto the street, grabbing his jacket, waving at a red petit taxi, anxious face visible

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: in a hospital hallway NARRATOR grabs BROTHER_IN_LAW by the arm and asks him what happened, NARRATOR anxious, BROTHER_IN_LAW explaining with open hands, both faces visible

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: flashback: SISTER slips on the stairs of a tiled Moroccan apartment staircase, losing her balance, hands reaching for the rail, surprised face, non-graphic, no injury shown

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on plastic chairs in a hospital waiting area, elbows on knees, staring at a closed door, BROTHER_IN_LAW standing beside him with a hand on his shoulder

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR steps into the hospital room and sees SISTER in the bed with a bandaged forehead and arm in a sling, tears in his eyes, hand over his mouth, SISTER gives him a weak smile

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on a chair beside SISTER's hospital bed holding her hand; SISTER asks him a careful question, NARRATOR looks down, his face turning sad and tense, evening light through the window
